title: What Is the Story of Funchal Marina?
description: Ships once anchored off Funchal and landed people by rowing boat. The harbour wall grew from 1756, the marina came in the 1980s and was rebuilt from 2023.
heroAlt: Drone view of Marina do Funchal at midday, with pontoons, moored boats and the seafront avenue
keywords: what is the story of Funchal marina
